intro: A clear list of what is known, what is not known, and how each gap could be closed. Every row is written so it can be answered with a document instead of an opinion. Answers that do not exist yet are marked, not guessed.

groups.title: Account and link integrity
groups.note: These gate every commercial decision. Nothing else should be chosen before these are answered.

rows.q: Is the Associates account for shopnow047c-20 approved and in good standing?
rows.known: The ID matches Amazon's documented US format: Amazon states its software appends '-20' to all Store IDs.
rows.unknown: Whether the account is approved, and whether it is currently earning.
rows.how: Sign in to Associates Central and read the account status directly.

rows.q: Does a click on any supplied link appear in the Associates tracking report?
rows.known: None of the destination URLs observed during verification carried a visible tag parameter.
rows.unknown: Whether tracking happens server-side without a visible tag, and whether the click registers.
rows.how: Open one link in a signed-in browser, complete a test click that does not involve buying, and check the tracking report after 24 hours.

rows.q: Why does link.amazon/B0c8moW59 resolve to two different destinations?
rows.known: First fetch landed on a ThermoMaven product page. Second fetch landed on the Amazon homepage.
rows.unknown: Whether the code is retired, region-dependent, or rate-limited.
rows.how: Regenerate the link in SiteStripe and compare. Ask Amazon support if it persists.

rows.q: What are the five intended ASINs, as chosen by the account holder?
rows.known: Each short link resolves to an observed 10-character product ID, recorded separately.
rows.unknown: Whether those observed products are the ones the brief intended.
rows.how: Record the intended ASIN, the official listing URL, the confirmation date and the source as four separate fields per product.

rows.q: Are the supplied short links compliant Special Links?
rows.known: Amazon requires the Associates ID as a parameter in each link (2(b)) and prohibits cloaking or obscuring the destination (3(v), 3(w)).
rows.unknown: Whether these exact links satisfy those rules. This is unresolved and no claim is made either way.
rows.how: Inspect one link while signed in to the Associates account, and confirm the destination and tracking.

groups.title: Data access and automation
groups.note: The automation in the brief depends on an API the account cannot yet use.

rows.q: Does the account qualify for product-data API access?
rows.known: Creators API requires Associates enrollment plus at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days. PA-API 5 is deprecated and returns a 403.
rows.unknown: Whether the account meets the 10-sales threshold.
rows.how: Check the sales report for the trailing 30 days, then apply for Creators API access in Associates Central.

rows.q: What is the intended role of the research pipeline once data exists?
rows.known: The brief asks for trend detection, price analysis and commission estimation.
rows.unknown: Which of those are acceptable under the License, which restricts aggregating or repurposing product content.
rows.how: Read the IP License usage requirements before writing any scraper. Price history in particular may be restricted.

rows.q: Can price be shown to readers at all right now?
rows.known: Price and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link containing them, or the data comes via Creators API or PA API under the License.
rows.unknown: Nothing. The rule is clear, and the answer today is no.
rows.how: Either wait for API access, or rely on Amazon-served link widgets that carry their own price display.
rows.answer: Not currently permitted on this site.

groups.title: Measurement and audience
groups.note: The brief asks for growth decisions made from data. There is no data yet.

rows.q: Where will analytics events be received?
rows.known: Five events are defined and wired client-side. GitHub Pages cannot run a receiving endpoint.
rows.unknown: The collector host, the retention period and who can read the data.
rows.how: Choose between a small hosted endpoint, a scheduled worker writing flat files, or a hosted privacy-focused analytics service.

rows.q: What is the baseline traffic level?
rows.known: Nothing. The site published on 2026-11-20 and Search Console is not connected.
rows.unknown: Impressions, click-through, query set, and whether the site is indexed at all.
rows.how: Verify the domain property in Search Console, submit the sitemap, and record the first report date.

rows.q: Which question should the seventh guide answer?
rows.known: Six guides are published across two clusters.
rows.unknown: Which questions readers actually arrive with.
rows.how: Choose from Search Console query data after four weeks. Until then, write only what the product set clearly supports.

rows.q: Is a newsletter part of the plan, and if so under what consent model?
rows.known: A capture form exists and is deliberately disabled because nothing can receive an address.
rows.unknown: Provider, consent language, privacy notice, and whether double opt-in is required.
rows.how: Write the privacy notice first, then choose a provider whose consent flow matches it.

groups.title: Editorial standards
groups.note: The most important unanswered question on the site is who is speaking.

rows.q: Who is the named author, and what qualifies them?
rows.known: Copy is AI-assisted from verified source material, and the site says so.
rows.unknown: Whether a human editor will take ownership of the byline.
rows.how: Decide the byline model before adding author schema. Do not invent credentials.

rows.q: Will any product be physically tested?
rows.known: None has been. FTC guidance prohibits describing experience with a product you have not tried.
rows.unknown: Budget and appetite for buying test units.
rows.how: Approve a test protocol and a budget, or keep the site permanently spec-based and label it that way.

rows.q: May manufacturer certification claims be repeated?
rows.known: Product pages state certifications such as ETL and UL listings, and accuracy figures.
rows.unknown: Whether those are accurate, and whether repeating them is wise.
rows.how: Either verify against the certifying body's public listing, or attribute the claim to the manufacturer in the sentence itself.

rows.known: Product photography is not used on the site at all. Amazon images may only be used via Program Content under the IP License.
rows.unknown: Whether images will come from the Creators API, from manufacturer press kits, or not at all.
rows.how: Decide the imagery source, and record the license for each image if third-party.

groups.title: Brand and hosting
groups.note: Small decisions that are expensive to reverse later.

rows.known: The build uses 'ShopNow Reviews', derived from the supplied tracking ID prefix.
rows.unknown: Whether a different brand name is intended.
rows.how: Confirm before the domain is registered. Renaming after indexing costs redirects.

rows.q: Will the site stay on a project Pages path or move to a domain?
rows.known: It is published at /Affil2 on github.io. All internal links derive from one basePath setting.
rows.how: Choose before submitting the sitemap, because the sitemap URLs must match the canonical host.

rows.known: No contact address is published. FTC and platform expectations generally favour a visible way to reach the publisher.
rows.unknown: Which address to publish, and who monitors it.
rows.how: Publish a monitored address and a short editorial policy page.
